1_imagenet_pretrained_backbone.evidence: INV-10 explicitly specifies torchvision.models.ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1 in C21 protocol and C15 pre-training protocol.

2_one_input_channel_adaptation.evidence: INV-04 and Section 10 specify in_channels=1, conv1 shape [64, 1, 7, 7].

3_exact_conv1_adaptation_method.evidence: Section 10 explicitly specifies: Mean across the 3 RGB channels of pretrained weights (base_resnet.conv1.weight.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)).

4_decoder_head_initialization.evidence: Section 10 specifies PyTorch default module initialization for newly introduced decoder and head layers.

5_exact_random_seed_for_non_pretrained_p.evidence: Section 10 and INV-17 explicitly specify base seed 42 active during decoder/head initialization.

6_order_of_model_construction_and_loadin.evidence: Seeding with 42, loading pretrained ResNet18 backbone, copying channel-mean into conv1, instantiating decoder/head blocks sequentially, saving full state to initial_model_state.pt.
